scope.title: Context-pressure recovery of objective/unfinished/dependencies/recent evidence
scope.source: deterministic Working Context snapshot fixtures (no live provider)

decision.reason: Completed the remaining context-pressure half: a bounded, deterministic recovery projection over the Working Context snapshot with per-section drop counters (no silent drop), an explicit depth guard (no silent recursion) and complete:false always (no fake completion). The handoff-depth half was already landed by #179.

recovery.noSilentDrop: over-budget entries increment dropped[section] and set truncated=true; kept+dropped = total
recovery.noFakeCompletion: complete is always false; empty/absent snapshot -> status 'unknown'

handoffHalf.notes: sessions.createHandoff persists lineage before activation; cycles/truncated walks/corrupt JSONL/malformed config fail closed; depth bound opt-in runtime.handoff.enabled (default off, maxDepth 1-64, implicit 3); subagent maxSpawnDepth unchanged.

residual.assembly: The projection is provided; wiring it into a specific compaction injection point is integration-layer work.
residual.scope: No new ledger/store; no Stage 3 contract change; no product default/lock/approval change.

independentVerification.detail: Tests assert section recovery, drop-count conservation under a tiny budget, complete:false + unknown-on-empty, depth refusal, and digest determinism. Handoff-depth regression is covered by the #179 suite already on main. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: objective / unfinished / dependencies / recent evidence all recovered from the Working Context snapshot, deterministically.
Over-budget entries are counted in dropped[section] and truncated=true; kept+dropped equals the total candidate count.
depth beyond maxDepth returns status 'depth-exceeded' with no sections.
complete is always false; an empty snapshot is 'unknown', never 'recovered'.
Handoff chain depth/bounded recursion landed by #179 on main; subagent maxSpawnDepth and frozen values unchanged.
4 tests pass, tsgo:core 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: A separate second-agent independent verifier role.
